Nina - CS: FYI: Moonrise reserved bring-up set for Wed 09:00 PT. We need final quota, autoscale policy, and a smoke+stress test plan. Any conflicts?

Omar - SRE: I'm on it. What steady/burst numbers are we committing to?

Nina - CS: Steady ~550 RPS; bursts up to 1200 for up to 25m. Customer expects <0.5% errors first 24h, otherwise CS outreach.

Kai - Platform: Proposed test flow: canary 10% (10m) -> ramp to 100% over 25m -> hold 20m -> spike 1200 for 15m -> cool down. Canary routes with fallback to model-v1-compact when p99>1.4s.

Leah - Solutions: They have many repeated prompts; recommend KV prefix priming and 30 canonical prompts for regression checks. I'll prepare runbook and prompts.

Omar - SRE: Autoscale suggestion: min=3, target_util=62%, cooldown=90s, max=9. Quota burst token=1300. Add alert: "moonrise.errors > 0.5% over 5m" to paging. Watch host-3 GC and GPU mem.

ops-bot: loadtest/moonrise-stress-17555 started (job id: lt-17555) :rocket:

Kai - Platform: Test finished; summary: steady p95=360ms p99=920ms errors=0.08% GPU=69% KVhit=79%. Spike p99=1.58s errors=0.62% during spike window. Full metrics -> s3://redwood-loadtests/moonrise/175555/results.json

Omar - SRE: Slightly over the 0.5% threshold on spike. Recommend: route spike traffic to compact model and add +1 replica for initial handoff window. Also enable temporary throttling rules for noisy clients.

Nina - CS: I'll set customer expectations and include SLA trigger in runbook. Action items: @Kai upload full graphs; @Omar apply autoscale + alert tomorrow AM; @Leah post runbook + prompts. Monday 08:30 PT sync to confirm handoff.

Leah - Solutions: Done — runbook and prompts uploaded to Drive and shared with customer.

ops-bot: loadtest/moonrise-stress-17555 completed (success).
